note: Rules engine config for the policy in this folder: what the payer's policy file has no structured field for, kept as data so it changes without a code change. `criteria` adds numbers to the policy's criteria when it loads; it may only add values: if the policy already sets a key, loading fails. Defaults from DECISIONS.md (panel defaults 2 and 3, D-029); the panel may revise them. `bindings` says how each criterion is evaluated: the evaluator kind, the comparison direction, the request-form fields checked for conflicts, and the provider-request wording (shape: apps/api/src/core/rules/bindingSchema.ts). Every criterion needs one, or the service does not start. Wording placeholders: {from} {to} = the look-back window, {value} {date} = the attested lab result, {months} = the attested months of therapy.

documents.missing: Documentation of an active type 2 diabetes diagnosis (problem list or visit note)
documents.conflicting: Clinical note confirming the type 2 diabetes diagnosis and its current status
Lab report for the HbA1c result reported on the request form ({value} % on {date})

alternatives.note: The policy's value_max 30 is read as strict "< 30", per its note (panel default 1).

documents.missing: Metformin prescription history for {from} to {to}, or documentation of metformin intolerance or contraindication
documents.conflicting: Metformin prescription or pharmacy fill history supporting the reported {months} months

documents.missing: Proof of member date of birth
Documentation of the diabetic condition, SNOMED 8455003 (problem list or visit note)
